title: Zed Editor UPDATE: NEW Agentic AI IDE - Cursor + Windsurf Alternative! FULLY FREE! (Open source)
summary: Promo-style walkthrough of Zed on Windows with Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Codex integrations.

assertions.quote: Honestly, it's way faster than most IDs I've tried

verdicts.note: Zed's Rust/GPU rendering is genuinely fast as an editor; agent speed depends on the model, not the editor.

assertions.quote: you also have the capability to implement other external agents inside zed ... thanks to the agent client protocol

verdicts.note: ACP (Zed/JetBrains) is an open protocol letting editors run external agents like Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Codex.
